_meta.purpose: Human-reviewed allowlist for applying F1CVehicle* to arg1 in the isolated SDK-lab IDB.
_meta.policy: Generated anchor matches are leads only. Approval requires constructor/caller evidence or direct access to the full vehicle layout.

approved.evidence: MainGameTickUpdate passes entries from the global active-vehicle array; direct vehicle fields.
VehicleObjectConstructor passes its vehicle this pointer directly.
Called with the unchanged vehicle this pointer by AIMainUpdate and AIRacingLine.

Writes the established vehicle driver-info region 0x4620..0x4898.

VehgenScnFileLoader passes its unchanged vehicle this pointer.
Despite the provisional name, it initializes established AI fields on the vehicle and forwards the unchanged pointer to vehicle AI methods.
PitStopReadyCheck passes pit_machine->vehicle; AIAbility passes its unchanged vehicle pointer.
SceneRenderUpdate supplies the same vehicle pointer later used by the vehicle AI chain.
First call in VehicleObjectConstructor with the constructor's unchanged this pointer.
Called with vehicle pointers from AIMainUpdate and pit/command paths; direct established vehicle fields.
Called with the unchanged vehicle this pointer by AIDriverStructInit; accesses full vehicle regions.
Directly evaluates established vehicle damage, lap, and pit-command fields; reviewed thiscall ABI.
AIAbility/AIPushLap pass vehicle this; disassembly explicitly derives pit controller as vehicle+0x32CC.
PitStopProgress passes pit_machine->vehicle; vehicle pit strategy callers pass unchanged vehicle this.
ForcePitExit restores vehicle ecx before the call; writes established vehicle field 0x454C-adjacent AI state.
Reviewed live ABI and direct vehicle max-speed field write.
Pit event application passes pit_machine->vehicle on the stack; direct full-vehicle fields and reviewed stdcall ABI.

rejected.reason: Arg1 is F1CPitMachine*, the embedded controller at vehicle+0x32CC. Vehicle anchors are reached indirectly through pit_machine->vehicle.
